# Piush KS – Engineering Knowledge Hub & Developer Tools

> Piush.com is the personal engineering portfolio, systems architecture blog, and privacy-first developer utilities platform created and maintained by Piush KS.

## Entity Overview
- **Name**: Piush KS
- **Role**: Senior Mobile Architect, Full-Stack Engineer, and Solopreneur
- **Experience**: 8+ years scaling production mobile applications and cloud platforms to 10M+ users globally.
- **Specializations**: Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), Flutter, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, and WebAssembly.
- **Canonical Domain**: https://piush.com/
- **Official Profiles**:

- [Systems & Architecture Blog](https://piush.com/blog/): 16 peer-reviewed technical deep dives on mobile runtime performance, memory leak profiling, database indexing, and zero-runtime frontends.

## Client-Side Developer Tools (100% In-Browser, Zero Telemetry)

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://piush.com/tools/json/): Client-side JSON formatting, syntax validation, tree visualization, and key sorting.
- [Developer Text Toolkit](https://piush.com/tools/text/): Multi-case string conversion (camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, kebab-case), Base64 UTF-8 encoding, and text hygiene.
- [Multi-Language Code Playground](https://piush.com/tools/playground/): In-browser code runner and compiler sandbox for Python, JavaScript, Java, C, C++, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, and Go.
- [SVG Studio & Optimizer](https://piush.com/tools/svg/): Interactive SVG editor, SVGO path optimizer, clean minifier, and PNG exporter.
- [UI Design Studio](https://piush.com/tools/ui/): Real-time visual generator for CSS glassmorphism, neumorphism, multi-layer shadows, and gradients.
- [OKLCH Color Space Studio](https://piush.com/tools/colors/): Modern perceptual color picker, 50-950 shade generator, and WCAG contrast analyzer.

## Key Technical Articles

- [Flutter Render Pipeline Deep Dive](https://piush.com/blog/flutter-render-pipeline-deep-dive/): RenderObject layout passes, paint boundaries, and 120 FPS frame budgeting.
- [Fixing Silent Memory Leaks in Node.js Services](https://piush.com/blog/preventing-memory-leaks-in-long-running-nodejs-services/): V8 heap snapshot analysis, closure traps, and stream hygiene under high concurrency.
- [PostgreSQL Indexing for High-Write Workloads](https://piush.com/blog/postgresql-indexing-strategies-for-high-write-workloads/): B-Tree vs. BRIN indexes, partial indexing, and write amplification mitigation.
- [Mobile Storage Benchmarks](https://piush.com/blog/sqlite-vs-realm-vs-mmkv-mobile-storage-benchmarks/): 100k row read/write benchmarks across SQLite, Room, Realm, and MMKV.
- [React Native New Architecture Production Benchmarks](https://piush.com/blog/react-native-new-architecture-production-benchmarks/): JSI, Fabric, and TurboModules memory and FPS metrics at scale.
- [The 3-Watt Micro-Server](https://piush.com/blog/repurposing-old-android-as-docker-server/): Running 24/7 low-power Docker containers on retired Android devices with Termux PRoot.
